title: Price levels across economies in 2021 (the ICP benchmark year): PPP conversion factor, market exchange rate, their ratio, GDP per capita at market rates and at PPP, with the WDI notes on the comparability of the exchange rate
source: World Bank, World Development Indicators (API v2): International Comparison Program (PPP) and IMF International Financial Statistics (exchange rates)
series: PA.NUS.PPP (ppp: PPP conversion factor, GDP, LCU per international $); PA.NUS.FCRF (fx: official exchange rate, LCU per US$, period average); NY.GDP.PCAP.CD (gdppc: GDP per capita, current US$); NY.GDP.PCAP.PP.CD (gdppc_ppp: GDP per capita, PPP, current international $); price_level = ppp / fx, computed by the fetch script (the US = 1); flag: from the WDI country notes ('SpecialNotes' in https://api.worldbank.org/v2/sources/2/country/<iso3>/series/PA.NUS.FCRF/metadata, read 2026-10-14 for every economy in the file): 'dual_rate:Y1-Y2' where the notes say 'multiple or dual exchange rate activity exists' and 'this applies to the period Y1-Y2' (WDI then uses an alternative conversion factor, so the official rate is not the rate the economy trades at in those years; 'unspecified' when the notes give no period); 'euro:YYYY' where the notes give the 'irrevocable euro conversion rate' that 'entered into force on January 1, YYYY' (WDI restates national-currency series such as the PPP factor in euros by a simple multiplier, but the official exchange rate stays in the old currency for the years before YYYY); 'other_unit' where the notes say the national accounts are provided or reported in another unit (Liberia: US dollars; Zimbabwe: Zimbabwe Gold). Several flags are separated by ';'.
citation: World Bank, World Development Indicators (last updated 2026-10-08); International Comparison Program 2021.
notes: 193 economies with all four values for 2021; regional and income aggregates excluded (region 'Aggregates' in the WDI country list). price_level is the ratio of the PPP conversion factor to the market exchange rate: the price of GDP in the economy relative to the United States at market exchange rates. Where the flag says the official rate is not comparable in 2021 or the PPP factor is in another unit (dual_rate covering 2021, euro after 2021, other_unit), price_level is not a price level: Croatia's PPP factor is in euros (euro from 2023) while its 2021 exchange rate is in kuna, so its ratio is 0.064. Chapter 5 leaves these economies out of the regression and says so.
